printed.title: FEBRUARY, 1884.
printed.description: Printed monthly calendar for February 1884: table of day of month/week, sunrise, sunset, moon sets and moon's phases, with engraved seasonal vignettes (signed Karst); footnote 'Heavy-face figures indicate from 6 P. M. to 6 A. M.'

marks.note: pencil, later archival pagination (front-matter sequence = seq minus 5)

transcriber_notes: Printed calendar page; no handwriting. Pencil archival page numbers run continuously 6-20 on seq 0011-0025 and stop after 0025 (none seen on later pages in this batch).
